title: Detecting Linguistic Indicators for Stereotype Assessment with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating race-related sentences from the CrowS-Pairs dataset by prompting LLMs (via few-shot in-context learning) to extract and classify linguistic indicators of stereotypes based on the SCSC framework (e.g., category label generalization, connotation, and situational explanations), which are then aggregated into a continuous stereotype score.
